verdict.rationale: Reducto's first-party quickstart and config docs show code written against an official client object (`client.parse.run(...)`, `client.parse.run_job()`, and chunking options passed through the client), which indicates an official SDK covering the core endpoints. A published OpenAPI spec also supports building against the API, though the pack never names the SDK packages or the languages they support. Missing for 10: explicit SDK package names and install instructions, the list of supported languages beyond the Python-style snippets, SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
